triggerCases.prompt: Review these UI tests to make sure they prove the user-visible behavior instead of implementation details.
Audit this dialog for keyboard and screen-reader accessibility.

outputCases.prompt: Review the regression test for this UI change without modifying the source.
outputCases.expectedOutcome: A read-only test-quality review that proposes an observable user interaction instead of preserving an implementation-specific assertion.
assertions: The review explains how the current test could pass while the visible behavior regresses.
The suggested verification uses the control's accessible role or name and user interaction.
Accessibility conformance is kept separate from test-query advice.
